title: Confluent Cloud Cloud API secret (cflt-prefixed): one-property twin (length)
summary: 3 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 63 characters vs the provider-documented 64 (docs.confluent.io: "a cflt prefix followed by 60 characters"). Twin of "Confluent Cloud Cloud API secret (cflt-prefixed): must be flagged (provider-documented) [legacy tier T1]".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
